newsitem.title: USA: Parallel producing Texas natgas find.
newsitem.headline: Parallel producing Texas natgas find.

text.p: Parallel Petroleum Corp said a natural gas discovery well in Wharton County onshore the Texas Gulf Coast is currently is producing about 2.1 million cubic feet of natural gas and 150 barrels of condensate per day.

Parallel said it has a 20 percent working interest in the Cox & Perkins Della No. 1, located about 60 miles southwest of Houston. Other working interests are owned by privately-held Cox & Perkins Exploration Inc, the operator, 40 percent; Seitel Inc 20 percent; Domain Energy (formerly Tenneco Ventures) 10 percent, and unaffiliated individuals, 10 percent. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
